info.title: REALTOR.ca Board API Documentation
info.description:
The REALTOR.ca Board API is a data distribution API that allows Boards to access Members and Offices roster information built on modern industry standards. Board Data API is normalized based on the RESO Data Dictionary standards. Boards can create data-sharing agreements with other boards, allowing them to pull roster information for any or all consenting partner boards. See Data Sharing Agreements appendix for details on how to set up data-sharing agreements between boards. The Board API data and endpoints are behind an authentication layer requiring a valid access_token. To access the Board API data or endpoints, include access_token with each call made to the API. The access_token can be generated by using the credentials provided and calling our authentication server. # Quickstart Overview This quickstart example will walk you through requesting the access_token and accessing the Board API endpoints by making API calls. For this guide, you can use any API client of your choice. ### Prerequisites To run this quickstart, you need the following prerequisites: - API Client of your choice - client_id - provided by CREA - client_secret - provided by CREA
### Step 1 - Get an access token An access token is required to make requests to Board API. To generate one, make a request to identity.crea.ca. The access token lasts for 60 minutes. **Example Request:** POST /connect/token Host: identity.crea.ca application/x-www-form-urlencoded Body grant_type : "client_credentials" client_id : "xxxxxxxx" client_secret : "xxxxxxxx" scope : "BoardDataApi.read" **Example Response:** The response includes the access_token. This is what you will use to make API calls to Board API. ```json { "access_token": "{access_ token}", "expires_in": 3600, "token_type": "Bearer", "scope": "BoardDataApi.read" } ```
### Step 2 - Make an API call to any resource available Proceed to make an API call to our member endpoint in Board API using the access_token generated in the previous step. Please note that all incoming REALTOR.ca Board API requests should include the 'Accept' header with a value of 'application/json'. **Example Request:** GET /Member Host: boardapi.realtor.ca Authorization: Bearer {access_token} Accept: application/json **Example Response:** Status: 200 OK ```json { { "pagination": { "skip": 0, "top": 100 }, "data": [ { "MemberFirstName": "John", "MemberMiddleName": null, "MemberLastName": "Barbisan", "MemberStatus": "Active", "MemberNationalAssociationId": "1029825", "OfficeNationalAssociationId": "1087778", "MemberAORKey": "6", "MemberNamePrefix": null, "MemberNameSuffix": null, "MemberNickname": null, "JobTitle": null, "MemberEmail": "barbisan@telus.net", "MemberAddress1": null, "MemberAddress2": null, "MemberPostalCode": null, "MemberCity": null, "ModificationTimestamp": "2021-10-08T09:36:00Z", "OriginalEntryTimestamp": "2006-06-20T17:48:00Z" } ] } ```
# Authorization Authorization for the Board API platform is done through an Identity Server. The Identity Server leverages OAUTH 2.0 to provide access tokens to Board API. ## API Access Tokens All data access for an application is authorized and authenticated using API tokens. For Board API we recommend using a server token to implement server-to-server API requests. Client-to-server API token requests create a security risk and could allow unauthorized access to your data feeds. Each request to the Board API requires valid credentials to obtain an access token. To request a token, send a POST request to the following endpoint. https://identity.crea.ca/connect/token The following fields should be in the request body and should be x-www-form-urlencoded. | Field | Description | | ----------- | ----------- | | client_id | The username of your Board | | client_secret | The password of your Board | | grant_type | Use the value client_credentials | | scope | Use the value BoardDataApi.read | The response will have the following fields when successful | Field | Description | | ----------- | ----------- | | access_token | The value of the requested access token | | expires_in | The time in which the token expires (in seconds). Should be 3600 by default.

NOTE: The token supplied is not a sliding token. After one hour a new token must be requested regardless. | | token_type | The type of token. It should always be Bearer. | | scope | It should always be BoardDataApi.read | After receiving the token, add the "Authorization" header with the bearer token to gain access to the API. ![auth-diagram](/Content/images/Auth_Diagram.png)
# Board API The Board API platform fetches Members and Office roster information built on RESO standards. Board Data API is normalized based on the RESO Data Dictionary standards. ## Error Codes The Board API may return the following HTTP status codes. For non-200 statuses, we also return an error object within the response body, with a message containing additional specifics about the error. | Code | Description | Message | | ----------- | ----------- | ----------- | | 200 | OK | N/A | | 400 | Bad request | Only integer values between 1-1000 are allowed for top.

Only non-negative integer values are allowed for skip.

Only true or false is allowed for count.| | 401 | Unauthorized access | Invalid or expired token.| | 404 | Not found | Invalid Endpoint. | | 408 | Request timeout | N/A | | 415 | Unsupported MIME type | N/A | | 500 | Unexpected Internal server error | N/A | | 503 | Service unavailable | N/A | | 404 | The requested office cannot be accessed as it either does not exist or the authenticated user lacks the necessary permissions to access it. | Unable to access the requested office.| | 404 | The requested member cannot be accessed as it either does not exist or the authenticated user lacks the necessary permissions to access it. | Unable to access the requested Member.|
## API Endpoints The following are endpoints defined by the Board API. | Endpoint | Description | URI | ----------- | ----------- | ----------- | | Office | Supplies a list of Office data. | /Office| | Office | Supplies a single Office data.| /Office/OfficeNationalAssociationId| | Member | Supplies a list of Member data.| /Member | | Member | Supplies a single Member data.| /Member/MemberNationalAssociationId| All endpoints are accessible through an authorization layer described in the next section. For a full description of the API endpoints, see the [API definition](#tag/Member).
## API Response All API responses are returned in json format. The API response can contain a single or multiple data records. For complete details of data models in the API see the [Models](#tag/member_model) section of the API Definition.
## Paginating through results In order to minimize the data returned in a single query, results are paginated. By default, a page will contain a maximum of 100 results. This value can be increased using the top query parameter, increasing the page size to a maximum of 1000 records. Total record count will be provided in response when count is set to true in the request. To determine total amount of pages, the count query parameter should be used to retrieve the total amount of records which should be divided by the page size. Note that the count parameter increases the overhead of a request therefore it is recommended that the total count of the data is requested once and not for each request of a page. Users can use skip request parameter to retrieve the next page if the record count is greater than returned number of records in response. **Example Response:** ```json { "pagination": { "count": 2525, "skip": 101, "top": 100 }, "data": [...] } ``` ## Testing Requests To test any request in the Board API you will need to send an access token which cannot be done through a typical web browser. Postman (https://www.postman.com/) is the preferred option to test out any request in the API quickly, however there are other tools available that may be your preference. Below are a few screenshots taken from Postman that outline typical requests. ### Requesting A Token ![Example Token Request](/Content/images/Request_Token.png) ### Requesting A Member ![Example Member Request](/Content/images/Request_Member.png)
## Example of Requests **Get a list of members for a specific MemberAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Member?MemberAORKey=1234 **Get a list of inactive members for a specific MemberAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Member?MemberAORKey=1234&MemberStatus=Inactive **Get a list of members for all accessible MemberAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Member **Get a list of inactive members for all accessible MemberAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Member?MemberStatus=Inactive **Get a single member by MemberNationalAssociationId:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Member/1234 **Get a list of offices for a specific OfficeAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Office?OfficeAORKey=1234 **Get a list of inactive offices for a specific OfficeAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Office?OfficeAORKey=1234&OfficeStatus=Inactive **Get a list of offices for all accessible OfficeAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Office **Get a list of inactive offices for all accessible OfficeAORKey:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Office?OfficeStatus=Inactive **Get a single office by OfficeNationalAssociationId:** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Office/1234 **Get a list of offices that have been modified greater than or equal to the provided ModifiedTimestamp** https://boardapi.realtor.ca/Office?ModificationTimestamp=2021-10-08T09:36:00Z # Support and Updates If you have any questions about using the APIs available on the platform, contact support at support@realtor.ca Currently support is only offered in English.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Skips this number of results. Default: 0

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Request the server start at other than the first record in the set of matching records. Default: 0

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Request the server to apply a limit on the number of records returned. Default: 100. Maximum of 1000 records enforced.
